subject.title: fix(runtime): drop intermediate monologue text blocks from visible delivery

question: Should this hidden-reasoning delivery fix require redacted live Discord main-session or equivalent runtime proof before merge?
rationale: The patch shape looks correct from source review, but the affected boundary is user-visible hidden reasoning delivery and the contributor reports they cannot produce live Discord proof without maintainer help.

options.title: Require live delivery proof
options.body: Hold merge until the PR body includes a redacted Discord main-session or equivalent runtime transcript, log, screenshot, or recording showing the monologue block is not delivered.

options.title: Accept unit-only proof
options.body: Maintainers could merge based on source-level regression coverage, but they would own the unproven live provider/channel behavior for this security-sensitive boundary.

options.title: Pause until proof access exists
options.body: Leave the PR open while a maintainer decides whether to run the credentialed proof path or provide a fixture/rig the contributor can use.

recommendation.title: Require live delivery proof
recommendation.body: Hold merge until the PR body includes a redacted Discord main-session or equivalent runtime transcript, log, screenshot, or recording showing the monologue block is not delivered.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent phased delivery and provider streaming work is closest to the source boundary being proven.
